$comment: SHARED GStack settings — committed on purpose so every developer gets the same enforcement.
Personal preferences and permission allow-lists belong in .claude/settings.local.json, which stays gitignored.
This file wires .claude/hooks/gstack-guard.js as a PreToolUse hook: it BLOCKS unapproved commits,
force-push, blanket `git add -A`, writes to secret files, and any attempt to edit the guard itself.
Every other GStack rule (design gate, requirements gate, verdict gates) is instruction-only in CLAUDE.md.
